summary: Frontend dark theme redesign testing completed. All 7 specified features verified working correctly. SwimQual.app now displays professional dark-themed, mobile-first design with glassmorphism cards, gradient buttons, and functional bottom navigation.
passed_tests: Login screen displays dark theme (#0a0f1a background) with glassmorphism card and gradient login button (sky-500 to blue-600)
Dashboard shows hero card with pool image, personalized greeting ('Ready for the Heat, Alex?'), and season status
Dashboard shows profile card with gradient avatar (emerald-600 to teal-700) and athlete details (11-12 Male)
Event cards display glass-card styling with USA Time badges (B level shown for 50 Free)
SCY course badges properly displayed on event cards
Focus screen shows AI Technique Coach section with gradient icon and Generate Tips button
Focus screen shows Stroke Guide section with stroke buttons (Freestyle, Backstroke, Breaststroke, Butterfly, IM) in dark glass styling
Team screen (Admin view) shows Share Team button with pink-purple gradient styling
Team screen shows Add Swimmer button with blue gradient styling
Swimmer cards display glass styling with gradient avatars (A, S, L initials)
Bottom navigation works correctly with highlighted active tab (sky-500 blue background)
Navigation between Dashboard, Results, Focus, and Team screens functional
Event detail screen shows dark theme with glass cards, time history, and progress chart
Register screen shows dark theme with glassmorphism card and green gradient button
Desktop layout properly renders 2-column grid for event cards
test_credentials: Demo accounts: Alex (swimmer), Maria (parent), Sarah, Admin - available via quick login buttons on login screen
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark theme redesign fully implemented and tested. Key styling classes: glass-card (glassmorphism effect), bg-[#0a0f1a] (navy background), gradient buttons using from-sky-500 to-blue-600. Fonts: Barlow Condensed for display, Inter for body text. Bottom navigation uses data-testid attributes (nav-dashboard, nav-focus, nav-admin, nav-roster). USA Swimming Motivational Time badges functional with B level displayed for Alex's 50 Free time.
